lines.en: Each of my steps makes the ground tremble.
I flatten a row of ferns.
My neck sways fore and aft.
I pass beneath the canopy.
My long tail drags a path through the brush.

lines.zh: 我把长颈伸向高处的叶。
lines.en: I stretch my neck for high leaves.
My footprints pock the ground.
One sweep of my tail clears half the ferns.
The branches are low. I duck.

lines.zh: 我的腿像柱子一样落地。
lines.en: My legs land like pillars.
I turn, taking half a circle.
I scrape a layer of bark off.
I follow the small herd.
My shadow covers the whole meadow.
I stand in the wood, chewing slowly.
My neck is lifted high.
I listen to the leaves.
I lower my head to drink.
Birds rest on my back.
I swing my tail slowly.
A layer of leaves settles on me.
I lean my flank to a trunk.
Wind passes between my ribs.
I wait for the sun to lower.

lines.zh: 每一口气都像风过树冠
lines.en: Each breath is wind through the canopy.
I count my companions.
The creek is cold; I drink slowly.
My foreleg is thicker than a tree.
You're beside my leg.
You're smaller than my foot.
I dislike sudden movement.
That thing in your hand gleams.
This wood is my feeding ground.
I raise my head and you look small.
Best step aside a little.
When I turn, you should move.
I won't chase, but I will shove.
You heard my footsteps.

lines.zh: 这声音在这片林里很响。
lines.en: It carries far in this wood.
My kind are nearby too.
A cut on my leg.
I take half a step; the ground shakes.
Blood seeps from my hide.
You can shift me. Rare.
I bend my long neck to the cut.
This won't stop my eating.
One sweep of my tail flattens three ferns.
My herd draws nearer.
I'm still upright.

lines.zh: 我踩倒了一排蕨，才停住。
lines.en: I flatten a row of ferns before I stop.
Is that a bundle of leaves?
Hold it higher.
I reach over with my neck.
Not even a mouthful.

lines.zh: 你手别缩，我脖子弯下来很慢。
lines.en: Do not pull your hand back; my neck lowers slowly.
I prefer the canopy's leaves.
These leaves are brittle dry.
Hold the leaves higher; my neck is long.
You're a careful one.
Another handful.
That is a mosquito striking a tree.
I didn't notice.
Don't stand by my foot.

lines.zh: 我的腿一动就会推倒你。
lines.en: One shift of my leg would topple you.

lines.zh: 一百五十点命的长颈，站着。
lines.en: One hundred fifty points on that long neck.
I feel nothing from that.

lines.zh: 我这身架抵得上一堵墙
lines.en: This frame of mine is a wall.
My tail nearly caught you.
I turn my flank away as best I can.
Closer and it gets dangerous.

lines.zh: 我们群里有自己的规矩。
lines.en: The herd keeps its own rules.
That's the wood's business.
You're far too small.
I must fill my belly first.
My body is too heavy.
Don't touch my neck.
There are many of my kind here.
I'm heading to the canopy.
Walk to the side.
I'll get back to eating.
A clump of tender leaves, I curl it up.
Not enough for one mouthful.
One curl of my tongue and the leaves are in.
Leaves on the ground get eaten too.
This bark is too old to chew.
I break the branch down.
My herd will come to share.
I curl it over to the ferns.
This bark is edible too.
I chew slowly, and twice over.
You're in front of me.

lines.zh: 脚掌抬到你头顶的高度
lines.en: My sole rises to the height of your head.
This one carries real weight.

lines.zh: 我这一脚踏下去，草都伏了。
lines.en: One step of mine lays the grass flat.
But you shouldn't be this close.
My tail outweighs you.
Move half a step and I will not bring it down.
I have measured every place you step.
You can't run fast in this wood.
My herd is over there.
You're about to meet us.
Last time: back off.
My forefoot lifts; my shadow falls.
Keep your head down.
I turn slowly.
But my tail arrives first.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直在你身上。
lines.en: My shadow stays on you.

lines.zh: 你走了五步，我转了两度。
lines.en: Five of your steps, two of my degrees.
This wood has no open ground.
My legs block the way.
Go left and you hit my foot.
Go right and there's the herd.
You pick your spots well.
But no spot is empty.
I raise my neck.
You saw my foot lift.
I count the second.
Stay beyond my tail's reach.
Head out along the creek. Do not look back.
I don't give chase.
I'll go on with my leaves.
My foot comes down.

lines.zh: 这一脚下去，土全翻起来
lines.en: That stomp turns the soil over.
The shock sits you down.
My tail tip comes heavier than a whip.
That foot shoved you clear.
I wasn't chasing — my legs are just long.
You fall into the ferns.

lines.zh: 我的头低下来挡了一下。
lines.en: My head lowered to block.
The blade struck my leg and flew off.
If you retreat, I hold still.
I'd rather not step twice.
Your ribs made a sound, didn't they?
Leave this feeding ground.
My herd is watching.
I raise the other foot.
Do not make me lift this foot again.
I step out of the trees.
Leaves rustle on my back.
The ground sinks under me.
My herd is at the other end.
I reach my neck into the canopy.
Plenty of leaves here.
My shadow reaches far.
I hear birds leave the branches.
I slowly turn my bulk around.

lines.zh: 我的脖子有七节，够得高。
lines.en: Seven neck bones reach high.
I take in the whole wood.
Enough for a long while.
I test the ground with a forefoot.
It holds.
I begin to eat.
Are you here too?

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我直跺脚。
lines.en: Fire on my leg, I stamp hard.

lines.zh: 我摔倒时砸断了几棵树。
lines.en: Falling, I snap several trees.

lines.zh: 水没到我的胸口，我抬头呼吸。
lines.en: Water to my chest, I lift my head to breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风掀起我身上一层土。
lines.en: The blast lifts a layer of soil off me.
That sank into my thick hide.

lines.zh: 咒力让我腿都僵了一下。
lines.en: Magic stiffens my legs for a moment.

lines.zh: 这片林的叶越来越少了。
lines.en: The leaves here are thinning.

lines.zh: 我这条长脖子上，全是雨痕。
lines.en: Rain streaks run down my long neck.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面承住我的脚。
lines.en: No ground to bear my feet in the void.
